Aisha K.: FYI I ran a quick cross-model scorecard comparing nyx9b and zephyr11b for the GTN chat workload (quant experiments included). dropping the summary here for product & ops to weigh in. link: https://bench.internal/cross/3245 :clipboard:
Daniel M.: thanks. can you paste the topline numbers for recall/latency/cost?
Aisha K.: top-level (sample n=6k, multi-turn slices):
- nyx9b-int8: recall@5=0.771, p95 latency=190ms, cost/1k=$0.21
- nyx9b-int6: recall@5=0.758, p95 latency=140ms, cost/1k=$0.15
- zephyr11b-int8: recall@5=0.804, p95 latency=260ms, cost/1k=$0.30
- zephyr11b-int6: recall@5=0.796, p95 latency=200ms, cost/1k=$0.22
Delta notes: nyx int6 vs int8: -0.013 abs (-1.7% rel) recall, huge latency wins; zephyr int6 vs int8: -0.008 abs (-1.0% rel) recall, latency wins too but smaller.
Carmen V.: interesting — zephyr keeps higher absolute quality across both quants but costs more. how concentrated are the regressions?
Aisha K.: regressions concentrated on entity-tracking long dialogs and instruction-chained prompts. single-turn summarization parity. I did KV ablations for both: keeping last-3 layers KV in float16 recovered ~60% of the drop for nyx-int6, ~30% for zephyr-int6. artifacts: s3://bench/cross/3245/artifacts.zip
bench-bot: run recorded: run_id=3245, commit=af12d3, variants=[nyx9b-int8,nyx9b-int6,nyx9b-int6-kvfp16-last3,zephyr11b-int8,zephyr11b-int6,zephyr11b-int6-kvfp16-last3]. diff report at s3://bench/cross/3245/diff.html
Daniel M.: product asks: what's the unit-econ tradeoff if we standardize on nyx-int6 vs zephyr-int6 as baseline? baseline GTN traffic ~150M tokens/mo.
Aisha K.: quick calc: 150M tokens = 150k * 1k tokens. Costs: nyx-int6 @ $0.15 => $22,500/mo. zephyr-int6 @ $0.22 => $33,000/mo. Delta = +$10.5k/mo (~46.7%). Quality: zephyr-int6 recall@5=0.796 vs nyx-int6=0.758 => +0.038 absolute (~5% relative uplift).
Carmen V.: product: is the ~5% recall uplift worth a 47% cost increase? any middle ground?
Aisha K.: options: (1) hybrid fleet: route higher-signal or high-value customers to zephyr-int6, rest to nyx-int6. (2) keep nyx-int6 but do KV-last3 FP16 for long-history requests (recover ~60% of recall gap). (3) route only long-history/multi-entity dialogs to zephyr-int6 (should be ~12% of tokens).
ProductBot: product note: target is to keep user-visible regressions below 1.5% recall loss vs current prod. Also prioritize solutions that avoid >10% cost uplift for GTN unless tied to revenue signal.
Daniel M.: run cost for the 3 options with rough traffic splits:
- Option A (full zephyr-int6): cost = $33k/mo (+$10.5k)
- Option B (nyx-int6 + KV-last3 FP16 for 18% long-history traffic -> assume +2% perf cost): nyx cost baseline $22.5k + small infra dp cost ~ $450 => ~$22.95k (+$450)
- Option C (hybrid routing: 12% tokens to zephyr-int6, 88% to nyx-int6): cost = 132k*$0.15 + 18k*$0.22 = $19.8k + $3.96k = $23.76k -> +$1.26k (~5.6%)
Aisha K.: recovery/quality expected: Option A best quality, Option B recovers ~60% of gap (reduces recall delta from 0.038 -> ~0.015), Option C recovers most of the gap where it matters (long-history) and should get recall delta down to ~0.01 overall based on weighted slices.
Carmen V.: recommend Option C as pragmatic: small cost uplift, targeted quality improvement. we still need a canary to validate user signal.
Daniel M.: agree. propose holdback: 1% -> 5% -> 12% routing windows for long-history slice only. make the route: `route.if(multi_turn && history_tokens>2500 && customer_tier!=enterprise).dest = zephyr11b-int6` (enterprise always routed to zephyr11b by contract).
Aisha K.: I'll prepare the canary artifacts and a small signal-check dashboard: recall@5 by history bucket, latency p95, token burn, and top 50 diffs. will also add the KV-last3 FP16 variant to experiment matrix as fallback if routing causes cost concerns.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-07-09T00:00:00Z -> 2026-07-09T04:00:00Z. canary_id=canary-cross-3245. Owner=@Aisha K.
Daniel M.: please also add economic alert: if cost burn delta >8% over baseline in 24h, auto-roll back routing rule.
Aisha K.: will do. I'll post canary dashboard link and a short summary after the 1% run completes. :rocket:
